cohort: The study included 60 pregnant women between 20-30 weeks gestation diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus based on DIPSI criteria.
finding: Metformin showed advantages in fasting glucose control, fewer neonatal complications (specifically, lower non-significant neonatal hypoglycemia), and better patient compliance, while postprandial glucose was better controlled with insulin.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in the mode of delivery between the metformin and insulin groups.
